notes: Beta: linked Spotify and Apple Music playlists were quietly re-syncing every hour instead of every six — that's fixed, and songs the downloader can't find are now remembered and reported instead of being searched for over and over (with a "Retry missing songs" option when you want another go). Song titles with accents in them now reach listeners intact. Adding music no longer files the same song twice under two different names, shuffle nudges your least-played songs forward, and the server keeps a much smaller log.
